38716.synopsis:
Yaoying transmigrated into a novel.
In the chaotic and troubled times, many nations were at war. Her father happened to be the most powerful of those vying for supremacy, her brother turning out to be the male lead that finally dominated the Central Plains.
As the male lead’s younger sister, Yaoying was ready to accept this benefit that came without her having to lift a finger.
But it turned out that the male lead hated her to the bone, going as far as to have her marry the sixty-year-old grassland tribal chief in place of the female lead.
Yaoying was forced to marry. Wolves in front, tigers in the back—beasts surrounding her—all coveting the lovely-as-a-flower Chinese princess.
At the moment of crisis, the novel’s young and legendary lord who was destined to die young passed through with his troops.
To escape from their clutches, the trembling Yaoying pointed at the sickly lord: This princess fell in love with you at first sight. If you won’t marry, I’ll seek you out with a dowry!

He decided to find an auspicious place to die.
But while he didn’t die, the zombies around him did.

Yes, Wen QingLing became a zombie, but he mutated.
He breathed, had a heartbeat, and had consciousness, there was practically no difference between him and humans.
He had authority over zombies, his wounds healed themselves, and where his blood was spilled, life was restored.
Wen QingLing returned home to help his zombie parents regain their consciousness and restored their decomposing bodies back to their original appearance.

49468.synopsis:

Having lost all hope, he walked every corner of the world accompanied by a spiritual jade containing a single fragment of Ye Zhou’s soul, wishing only to find the other pieces so they could be with one another in a next life.
However, one day, near the end of his life, he wandered into an illusion and suddenly saw Ye Zhou being chased by several beasts.
When he slew those beasts, a strange sound rang by his ears.
“Ding! For slaying a monster, you’ve received 3 low-grade spirit stones.”
“Ding! For slaying a monster, you’ve received a secret book, the Reverse Sword Technique.”
“Ding! For slaying a monster, you’ve received a rare healing item, the Spirit Replenishing Herb.”
“Ding! You’ve gained a level and restored 1% of your cultivation.”

Ye Zhou only thought he had taken a good-looking little disciple, helping him level up step by step, and after flirting for a long time they married each other in the game.

[Player Yi Ye Pian Zhou has triggered the final storyline, ‘Sword Tomb’, and unlocked the final boss, Dugu Zhuo.]

49980.synopsis:

Cen Jin, who only wanted a miscellaneous diploma, found out that the usual lesson of this technical school was: teaching them how to slay a god!

-Do not trust all the Gods.
-If you encountered the mysterious (Grim Reaper) and failed to seek help, then adopt these actions: Negotiate, pounce, dominate, and kill. Do not stop until you’re on your last breath.

As an extra among extras, who didn’t even exist in the novel.
I tried to accept reality and live peacefully…
But for some reason, I ended up enrolling in the academy, which is the main setting of the novel.
And that too, in the position of the female lead’s childhood friend.

93244.synopsis:
In a modern world where high technology is advanced, the concepts of feng shui and destiny still flourish amidst tall buildings and narrow alleys. There are always those who, while sailing smoothly, suddenly encounter unforeseen changes or suffer from inexplicable disasters.
Ding! Lin Su opened his phone: You have a new order.
He dismissed the notification, tucked his notebook under his arm, and leisurely stepped outside. Everywhere he looked, the birth dates and times of people were neatly arranged above their heads.
In this vast world, there exists a position called a Fate Immortal.
With a single glance, one can discern good from evil; with a stroke of the pen, one can alter the fate chart.
·
Students who play tricks to secure admission slots, young masters who exchange lives to enter wealthy families, stars who steal fortune to seek dazzling careers…
They exhaust all sinister means, using unorthodox methods to snatch lives that do not belong to them.
But they never considered that the destiny could be set right with a mere stroke of the Fate Immortal’s pen.
Lin Su flipped through the fate ledger: Let me see who is causing trouble this time.
[It is recommended to open the author’s notes for some key hints and smooth silly skits, doubling the fun.]

95804.synopsis:
When the adventurers at the local tavern burst into laughter watching KonoSuba: God’s Blessing on This Wonderful World!—
When the death rate among rookie adventurers drops dramatically thanks to Goblin Slayer—
When the world’s understanding of mages is upended by the arrival of Fate/Zero—
When The Garden of Sinners begins airing nonstop on the very first magic-powered television—
When Steins;Gate inspires scholars to chase the mysteries of the unknown—
When JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure introduces an entire generation to the fabulously flamboyant world of vampire villains—
When Spice and Wolf ignites a merchant boom across the continent—
When Re:Zero changes society’s view of half-elves forever—
When Puella Magi Madoka Magica reveals the dark, twisted truth behind the origin of the world—
—all of that has yet to happen.
But one man is about to change everything.
Armed with his magitech alchemy, his knowledge of countless legendary works, and a relentless passion for storytelling, the eccentric Mage-Director Edward Durin has made a bold decision:
He will bring anime to this fantasy world.
He will awaken the people to the beauty of 2D.
He will ignite a watching-anime boom the likes of which this realm has never seen!
The stage is set.
The cameras are rolling.
The otherworldly anime revolution begins now!

97340.synopsis:
This age-gap Omegaverse story follows Kawachi, an Omega striving to live as a Beta, whose plans are disrupted by an unexpected incident just before his 35th birthday.
Inukai, a young Alpha from the sales department who has secretly admired Kawachi, steps in to help, intertwining their lives in ways neither expected.
This is a heartfelt story of love, family, and personal growth between a devoted younger Alpha and a kind-hearted Omega pursuing a new path in life.

98620.synopsis:
Grow the guild and train Awakeners!
The Hunter training game, ‘Guild Manager’.
Veteran player Lee Shin creates yet another character today.
『The Charismatic Genius’ Guild Management』
“I may lack abilities, but how about maxing out charm instead?”
Hmm, let’s set social reputation to zero here?
Games are always more fun when they’re challenging!
But… things shouldn’t have turned out this way.
When he opened his eyes again, he found himself possessing someone.
Possessing none other than the spoiled heir of a chaebol family he had created—perfect in appearance but useless otherwise!
“Well, at least I’m a third-generation chaebol, and my looks aren’t bad, right?”
“Alright, let’s put this to good use!”
Enemies surround him on all sides, but so what?
Now that it’s come to this, he’ll show them what a true veteran can do.
The legendary management of the charismatic genius guild master begins!

100156.synopsis:
After she transmigrated, the CEO of an international tea company, Ye Yaming, became the third young lady of a prominent Jiangnan tea house, having just come of age.
In the previous life, the Ye family was falsely accused, their property confiscated, and they were exiled. The original owner married a “phoenix man” and was ab*sed to death.
In this life, Ye Yaming took over and declared that these were not problems at all.
Tea-making was her expertise, and dealing with people was her forte. With the original owner’s memories from her previous life, changing the fate of the Ye family and the original owner was not difficult.
First, she issued a tea currency to solve the funding problem; then she made osmanthus tea to establish the reputation of Ye tea; next, she raised funds to expand the business, found a few partners for support, and casually set a trap for the opponent, returning a gift of a trap.
Ye Yaming clapped her hands: the future of the Ye family was secure. 
As for the “phoenix man,” that was even simpler. With a little bait, he would be ruined!
Facing the blank tea market and tea utensils in the Great Jin Dynasty, Ye Yaming’s entrepreneurial spirit soared: she wanted to create her first tea industry in this alternate Great Jin.

102716.synopsis:
I used to laugh while reading those so-called “women’s revenge” comics on social media, thinking, “There’s no way such a typical husband-stealing woman exists!” But after reincarnating as a poor noble lady, I actually became a victim of one.
Well, since my fiancé was the same gender as in my past life, I figured it wouldn’t work out anyway. I thought, “Staying single is fine by me!” and lived carefree. But then, my new fiancé turned out to be a super-elite, handsome man—so charming that even the man in my heart fell for him.
Ah… Maybe I wouldn’t mind having this man’s child.
associated_names: 「こんな横取り女いるわけないじゃん」と笑っていた俺、転生先で横取り女の被害に遭ったけど、新しい婚約者が最高すぎた。

103228.synopsis:
Congratulations on your enrollment in the Academy.
A grand battle against the endlessly encroaching yanderes awaits.
Conquer them with your gaslighting skills and lower-body prowess, honed over eight lifetimes.

105788.synopsis:
Zhang Zi, a corporate worker for an interstellar company, was on his way to another star system for business negotiations when he unfortunately crashed. However, this accident unexpectedly activated his Life Simulator.
Thus, Zhang Zi chose “Transform My Broken Body into Flames,” “Genetic Hacker,” and “Failed Art Student” to begin his first simulation.
“You were born on a planet where genetic technology is the core of civilization. You had a happy family and a childhood friend of the same age. The two of you grew up together, sharing an extraordinary bond.”
“Until the human disaster frontline collapsed, and the largest genetic corporation in the country launched a rebellion. You both lost your parents. From then on, you supported each other, grew together, took down the mastermind behind it all, and completed your revenge.”
“When you…”
associated_names: Simulation: After Becoming Living Flames, My Childhood Friend Regretted It for Life
模拟：身化烈焰后，青梅后悔终生

107324.synopsis:
Once upon a time, there was a little clerk who was especially afraid of flying. Every time before boarding a plane, he would leave some cryptic last words on Weibo.
These last words led a SWAT officer to see him as one of their own.

109628.synopsis:
Xin Hexue died twice. The first time, he was the sickly crown prince of a small and remote planet, and later, he was reborn in the womb of a disposed consort in the cold palace.
Dragging his sickly body, coughing up blood every few steps and at the slightest breeze, he still ascended to the imperial throne.
And then, he was poisoned to death.
Someone once asked him, “What do you want the most?”
Xin Hexue didn’t hesitate: “To stay alive.”
The system that bound him gave him a promise: as long as he could gain enough love and heart-break values from the target characters, he could go to a new world and live a long life.
To Xin Hexue, this task wasn’t difficult.
It was just that, in every world, he seemed to have strange illnesses…

110140.synopsis:
[ Awakened Beauty vs. Cold and Ruthless Sword Master ] 
Lin Yunqing, a regular worker in the modern world, was transported to a novel about a powerful female protagonist after a car accident. She was neither the lucky Bai Susu, the main character who was blessed with countless opportunities, nor Zhou Yulong, the talented first female supporting character. Instead, she was a cannon fodder character, a nameless female character who existed only to help Bai Susu better understand the Five Spirit Art.
In the novel’s opening chapter, Lin Yunqing was deemed a “water and fire clashing” dual-spirit root during the grand ceremony of the Taiqing Sect. This meant her cultivation path would be fraught with difficulties.
Determined to avoid the drama between the main character and the supporting female character, Lin Yunqing focused on her cultivation. However, she unexpectedly obtained a Spirit Cleansing Herb, which successfully removed her fire spirit root, leaving her with a pure water spirit root. Nourished by the water aura, her beauty became even more captivating, her eyes mesmerizing.
In the brutal world of cultivation, beauty without strength was a sin. When she encountered a strong, physically cultivated senior sister, Lin Yunqing chose the “Water Spirit Body Training Technique” in a moment of inspiration. This made her skin as smooth as jade and her body even more breathtaking.
Even the most beautiful woman in the cultivation world paled in comparison.
Song Zhiwei is the first genius in this world, born with sword bones, and enlightened by sword. She looks like the exiled immortal, and is the moon in the sky and the flower of Gaoling in the hearts of all female cultivators.
He thought he was born with a weak affinity, cold and cold, and only had the Tao in his heart, until she appeared…
associated_names: 修仙女配变成水灵根怎么办

111676.synopsis:
“Try lobbying me too.”
Humanoid gems possess the ability to fulfill any desire their master may have. Reborn as gems while retaining human memories, these humanoid gems are endowed with mystically beautiful appearances and limitless abilities. However, they are secretly traded by human hands, serving until their power is exhausted, at which point they are discarded. Their only wish is to one day meet their “fated master,” with whom they can be together forever.
Seok Ryu, a humanoid gem with the power of the “garnet” to enchant people. Constantly harassed and having clients stolen by Noeul, another “garnet” with the same kind of power, Seok Ryu one day seizes an unexpected opportunity to outshine Noeul and be chosen by Park Yejun, a poor, unknown actor.
To help Park Yejun, who lacks outstanding talent, presence, or confidence, succeed in the entertainment industry, Seok Ryu begins to wield their enchantment ability. They even manage to secure an exclusive contract with Songhyul Entertainment, a leading agency. However, for some reason, Seok Ryu’s enchantment ability doesn’t seem to work properly on Cha Yilhyun, the CEO of Songhyul, causing Seok Ryu to grow increasingly anxious…

111932.synopsis:
“In a world without Omegas, the appearance of Alphas is both a blessing and a curse. But now, the world’s only Omega has emerged.”
Yoon Siron, once a thriving film star in Korea, flees to Bargas City in America after causing the most humiliating scandal in entertainment history.
Pursued relentlessly by debt, he still dreams of making his acting comeback. He agrees to a highly lucrative clinical trial—but unbeknownst to him, it’s an experiment designed to genetically transform him into an Omega.
Meanwhile, in the lawless Bargas City, genetically modified Alphas emerge due to genome mutations. Their ticking time-bomb lifespans amplify their s*xual desires and violent tendencies. Rumors circulate on the dark web about a genetically engineered Omega, created solely for Alphas.
Now Siron must protect himself from the three men obsessively chasing him—and the countless Alphas tracking him down…

113980.synopsis:
At the high school Shirai Raito attends, the most beautiful girl in school, Kuroyuki Misaki, receives confessions of love every few days. These confessions have become a regular spectacle. However, Misaki consistently turns down every confession. Watching from a distance, Raito, an outcast, feels that someone unpopular like him lives in a completely different world from her.
But at a festival he attends with his little sister, he encounters Misaki being harassed by troublesome guys. Having no choice, he pretends to be her boyfriend to get her out of trouble. Unfortunately, their act is witnessed by other students, and rumors spread like wildfire.
To top it off, Misaki, finding the situation convenient, asks him to continue playing the role of her fake boyfriend…!?
It’s a sham, but sweeter and more frustrating than the real thing—a secret, youthful fake-couple rom-com begins!
associated_names: I Became the Boyfriend of the School’s Madonna, Who Had Turned Down Numerous Confessions, but Somehow, Without Realizing It, I Wasn’t Just Playing a Role Anymore
数々の告白を振ってきた学校のマドンナに外堀を埋められました

116540.synopsis:
Some original female leads couldn’t handle the obsessive, possessive love of yandere male characters—they ended up locked away, entangled in love-hate struggles. But Xie Lanyin? She lives for these beautiful, powerful, tragic yanderes.
So she showed up.
And once all those yandere male leads fell for her, the original heroines started to regret it.
But too late—he’s hers now, and no one can take him away.
World 1: The yandere general imprisons the fallen princess
Chu Jin’s mother was taken by the dog emperor into the palace, and his entire family was slaughtered—he was the only survivor.
At his darkest moment, the Fifth Princess appeared before him and offered him an umbrella.
Since then, he’s had one goal besides revenge: claiming the princess.
World 2: The yandere CEO keeps his canary
World 3: The yandere brute and his delicate sweetheart
World 4: The yandere crown prince of the capital calls her “Sister” every day
A sugar-sweet ride with healing on both sides—jump in and enjoy!
associated_names: 病娇文男主被嫌弃？我喜欢让我来

118332.synopsis:
Qin Qing possessed the character panel from a game—before her, everyone was like an open book. She even understood people better than they understood themselves. After all, no one could fully quantify and digitize every aspect of their being.
At first, she felt embarrassed about invading others’ privacy and had no idea what use the panel could be.
Until one day, while walking down the street, the panel suddenly issued a warning:
[Alert! Alert! High sin value individual detected ahead.] 
Qin Qing looked at the person and searched their name from the panel online, only to discover they were an A-level wanted criminal. She immediately reported them to the police.
The criminal was apprehended, and she received a substantial reward. Only then did she realize the panel could not only help her do meaningful things—but also make money!
Qin Qing began actively exploring the panel’s potential.
—
Lin Feng was the captain of the Criminal Investigation Division in Wuning District. Ever since Qin Qing reported that wanted fugitive, their office had entered a golden period: human traffickers, dog traffickers, spies, criminal suspects… case after case seemed to resolve itself with surprising ease. The only thing worth pondering was: every single case somehow involved Qin Qing.
Qin Qing: “Pure coincidence.”
Lin Feng: “Isn’t the frequency of these ‘coincidences’ a bit too high?”
Qin Qing: “Since you’ve figured it out, I won’t hide it anymore. Actually, I’m a master of metaphysics—commonly known as a fortune-teller.”
Admit that she was using some unknown piece of black technology? Not a chance!
Qin Qing became a young and well-known mystic, offering an incredibly wide range of services.
From evaluating a restaurant chef’s cooking skill level to discover hidden food gems, to analyzing personal aptitude scores to help the lost find career direction—she even helped the police with their work on the side.
Whenever someone questioned her, she would calmly reply:
“Yes, I calculated it. I can even tell how many times you wet the bed as a kid—want to keep listening?”
[Lin Feng is NOT the male lead. This story has NO romantic plot!!!]
associated_names: 我用人物面板伪装神棍

118588.synopsis:
As a strategist, Ni Yin was deeply rejected by the “Heavenly Dao,” and in every world, she was dealt a terrible hand.
But so what? She liked it when others underestimated her, looked down on her, got angry at her, and resented her—only to end up falling for her anyway.
[The vain, gold-digging girlfriend in college? Nope. She was the flirtatious beauty who made the cold academic god and the fiery campus heartthrob fight over her.] 
—”Your girl’s fine. The next second, she’s mine.”
[The selfish childhood friend who broke up a ship in the entertainment industry? Nope. She was the sly little green tea adored by the entire internet—even the film emperor was mesmerized by her.] 
—”I knew it! She is into me!”
[The plain-faced, opportunistic physician girl in the martial world? Nope. She was the innocent bait who made the once-indifferent romantic young lord fall uncontrollably for her.] 
—”I was first… clearly, I was first.”
[The twisted, copycat younger sister in a wealthy family? Nope. She was the crimson beauty mark on the heart of the domineering CEO who kept breaking his own rules for her.] 
—”Being the third? So what—this is a legendary love.”
[The selfish, hated female side character in the apocalypse? Nope. She was the natural-born siren who made all the doomsday powerhouses tear each other apart for her.] 
—”Tch, like I’d fall for her?”
[The scheming third wheel in a dating reality show? Nope. She was the beautiful little mermaid who unknowingly charmed everyone around her.] 
—”I’ve discovered your secret…”
Note: The female lead loves to act and knows how to flirt. Everything she does is to conquer and to shine.
Each world has at least two romantic targets, with plenty of intense rivalry and chaotic love triangles.

121916.synopsis:
Liu Yuetang was cast off to a rural estate by her stepmother the moment she was born. On the year she came of age, her legitimate sister backed out of entering the palace due to a dream and instead stole her betrothal—spending the wedding night with her fiancé.
Seizing the moment, Liu Yuetang chose to enter the palace herself and forge a brighter path. Once inside, she laid low, studied bedroom arts, mastered the art of seduction and restraint, and used every tactic at her disposal to claim a place in the emperor’s heart.
From a low-ranked yunu (court woman) to one of the four imperial consorts, it took her only two years.
Everyone said she was beautiful, but cunning—willing to use any means to climb the ranks. Only Liu Yuetang knew how perilous every step had been.
If she had shown even a sliver of mercy or hesitation, she’d never have made it to the top.
From beginning to end, what she wanted was never love or romance, but the emperor’s favor—wealth and power.
—
Xiao Heng grew up amidst scheming and deceit in the imperial palace. From the moment he ascended the throne, he knew he could never afford emotions, let alone a weakness.
So even when the naturally seductive Liu Yuetang entered his life, he only gave her favor and power—never his heart.
That is, until the day he saw her trapped in a sea of fire… and rushed in like a madman.
associated_names: 替姐入宮后，貴妃撩誘帝王上位

124220.synopsis:
One misstep—and Kai found himself transported to a world where Dueling reigns supreme.
In this world, bizarre card-based Trials appear!
Conquering these Trials earns rare and powerful cards.
Armed with the Deck he brought through transmigration and his deep knowledge of Dueling, Kai cleared Trial after Trial, claiming each unique card for himself.
Clearing the Blue-Eyes Trial, he obtained \[Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon] and the complete Blue-Eyes family pack!
Clearing the Red-Eyes Trial, he received the entire Red-Eyes lineup plus \[Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon] !
Clearing the Stardust Dragon Trial, he earned Shooting Star, Cosmic Blazar, and a full set of Junk cards!
Someone once asked Kai, “Are there any Trials even you find difficult?”
“If it’s Tearlaments,” he said, “then maybe a little.”
“Would you lose, then?”
Kai looked at the Deck in his hand—a full Maliss-Tearlaments deck and answered with confidence, “I’d win, of course.”
associated_names: 游戏王副本：开局一套电子龙

126012.synopsis:
When an Omega becomes A, all other Alphas move aside!
Shen Qingzhu was once the most beloved 3S Omega of the Lyman Empire. As the top student of the Royal Omega Ethics Academy, he was the gold standard for all Omegas in the Empire. Everyone was certain his name would one day appear in the textbook for Omega’s.
But one day he crossed over to a parallel world… and found he’d turned into an Alpha!
Shen Qingzhu, who’d spent his whole life playing the “perfect” Omega, now an Alpha: What a good thing. No one else in the world understands Omega better than me!
In the Empire plagued by “Straight-A Cancer”, Shen Qingzhu’s gentlemanly demeanor, warmth, and wholesome attentiveness quickly made him the shining light of all Omegas. The dog Alphas who used to look down on him ended up humbling themselves. They didn’t want to be lonely for a lifetime and begged to be taught how to win an Omega’s heart.
Shen Qingzhu: It’s about time to open an Alpha Ethics Training Class ?
————-
Ji Mingxue was an Omega so strong to the point he didn’t seem like an O.
As the undisputed top student of the Mecha Department at Imperial University, he was an SSS-level powerhouse at not even twenty years old.
What he hated most in life? The dog species called Alpha.
But when he unexpectedly went into heat after being schemed against, he encountered an Alpha completely unaffected by his pheromones.
The Alpha pulled out a gas mask without hesitation, and then smoothly injected Ji Mingxue with an Omega heat suppressant.
Ji Mingxue: Hiss… that hurts!
Shen Qingzhu, mistaking it for thanks: “You’re welcome. Please call me the Friend of Omegas! Don’t worry, I’m not one of those dog Alphas who take advantage of an Omega in danger!”
Ji Mingxue: ?
Wait but, did you forget your gender is also A?
Ji Mingxue: Very good. Little Alpha, you’ve successfully captured my attention.
【Gentle, considerate, pure-hearted, reserved, model Alpha, SSS-rank Alpha Shen Qingzhu】x【Cold to others but sweet to his person, super proactive, straightforward, SSS-rank Omega Ji Mingxue】
*slang used to describe Alpha who are stubbornly supportive of traditional gender roles and usually sexist and chauvinistic.
*Shen Qingzhu is the top!

129596.synopsis:
“Goal? To become the world’s greatest comic artist.”  
A comic artist’s life that ended regrettably due to an incurable illness.
In his second life, he is determined to become the absolute best.

138812.synopsis:
“Hah. If you smile at another bastard one more time…”
Teeth sank into her neck. Tears that had welled up spilled down her cheeks. Even at that moment, Gunwoo’s voice continued.
“I’ll gouge out his eyes, so you better watch yourself.”
His rough words dripped with possessiveness.
“You’re mine.”
Her mom’s friend’s son, Do Gunwoo.
And the girl who followed him around like a shadow her entire life, Yoon Hyena.
It’s been a year since Gunwoo left for an overseas assignment. During that time, Hyena resolved to let go of the feelings she had suppressed for so long. Her first love, which had withered away without even a proper confession, seemed like something she needed to leave behind.
But then…
“Why are you here?”
“Because this is my house.”
Six months into staying at Gunwoo’s place due to unavoidable circumstances, he suddenly returned without warning. To make matters worse, he also became her new team leader at work.
“Hyena, all men think the same way. They’re always plotting—how to get you under them, how to make you cry beneath them, how to make you theirs.”
“But… you’re a man too, oppa.”
“I know. I’m one of those bastards too.”
Gunwoo came back… different.
“I taught you everything—reading, writing, even drinking.”
“…”
“So I should teach you this too, right? Don’t you think so?”
The boy she once called “oppa” had become a man, and he was closing in on her, leaving no room to escape.

141628.synopsis:
After years of political promise, Princess Anita of Callithea finally marries Crown Prince Cedric of Laxion.
Having long admired him, Anita crosses the border full of hope, only to be met with scorn, humiliation and cold hatred by the man she once dreamed of loving.
“Go ahead and choose, Princess. Whoever catches your eye tonight will be the one to share your bed.”
Amidst the ruthless intrigues of the Laxion court and the growing unrest in her homeland, Anita struggles to endure.
Her resolve is tested again and again as Cedric’s cruelty intensifies, his hostility cutting deeper than any blade.
“If it’s what you want, I’ll give you everything. I’ll obey any order you give me.”
“What worth could your kneeling possibly hold for me?”
Day by day, her strength wanes.
The suffocating pressure and relentless despair leave her barely able to breathe.
And when she finally lashes out, the truth bursts forth like shattered glass.
“Do you regret it now?”
“Even if it hadn’t been him, anyone would have been kinder than you! No one could have been as cruel as your Majesty!”
Caught between the politics of nations and the confines of a loveless marriage, Anita can neither escape nor surrender.
It is only when she stands on the verge of breaking, her heart dry and crumbling to dust, that Cedric begins to realize.
“Damn it… What else could I possibly want from you? What more is there left for me to take?”
· ✦ ·
“Anita. That’s hardly how one begs properly, is it? Not when you’re dressed like that…”
The sheer negligée draped over her body shimmered faintly, revealing just enough of the soft curves beneath.
It wasn’t transparent, but it was too fine and delicate.
The line beneath her lowered stomach was too suggestive and indecent for any man’s eyes but his.
Cedric’s temper plummeted.
The desire burning in his chest turned cold and sharp, like ice driven into flesh.
‘How many men had seen her like this?’
Sensing the twisted shift in his demeanor, Anita flinched as though awaiting judgement.
“Go on then. Lift your skirt yourself. Raise it just enough… to make it worth looking at.”

143932.synopsis:
【Title – The Worst Degenerate in History】
Trust, Affection, and Charm decrease by 200.
I became a young noble in a tr*sh game.
And not just any noble—the worst degenerate in history.
No one trusts me, and my reputation can’t get any worse.
“Well, if I’m going to be cursed no matter what I do… I’ll show them what a real degenerate looks like.”
Thus began my survival story inside the game.
But… why does this actually feel like my true calling…?
associated_names: 망겜 속 공작가의 망나니로 살아남는 법

147004.synopsis:
Shen Ling transmigrated into a novel about a true-and-false heiress and became the vicious female supporting character.
In the novel, the supporting character was vulgar, malicious, and constantly schemed against the female lead, eventually meeting a tragic end.
To escape this miserable fate, Shen Ling decisively entered the palace. Even though the palace housed a tyrant, she lived honestly and kept her head down; surely the tyrant wouldn’t actually behead her?
Instead, she was promoted to Noble Lady, then Consort, and finally Empress.
Shen Ling: “Wait, did the tyrant pick up the wrong script?”
…..
Xie Yuanxun was an extremely terrifying, temperamental, and mu*derous tyrant.
Everyone feared him. Everyone dreaded him.
On the day of the imperial selection, when he saw the group of delicate beauties, he raised his blade with the intention of killing someone, only to suddenly realize he could hear Shen Ling’s thoughts.
While the other women cried in fear, Shen Ling sobbed along with them, trembling.
The tyrant happened to press his sword against Shen Ling’s neck and asked if she was afraid he would kill her.
Shen Ling, tears streaming down her face, said she wasn’t afraid, but inside her mind: “Are you insane? Of course I’m scared! If you swing that thing, I’m literally the first to die! I’m so unlucky! If you’re so tough, how about you hand me the sword and let me try?”
His killing intent disappeared instantly.
The tyrant thought: “Interesting.”
…..
A mentally unstable, spoiled attack-dog Emperor x salted-fish Empress who only wants to survive.

158780.synopsis:
After transmigrating into a yuri game, he becomes Raine, the adopted son of the heroine Rita’s family, and the story just so happens to reach the moment where he is about to sully Rita’s beloved childhood friend and is caught in the act by her.
If things continue like this, Raine is about to meet a catastrophic end—being accidentally beaten to death by his sister in a fit of rage.
“I never imagined that the family I lived with day in and day out would turn out to be such a beast hiding in human skin!”
“My foolish little sister! Do you even know how much I have suffered to have to sully your dear friend—”
associated_names: Becoming a Misunderstood Blond Hair in a Feng Aotian World
在凤傲天世界里成为误解系黄毛

172860.synopsis:
Wang Tianwei transmigrated from a post-apocalyptic world into the body of a “delinquent girl” in the interstellar era.
Not only does she have to struggle to keep up with the times and study hard to become a mecha pilot, but she also has to deal with psychological and emotional issues!?
Someone who’s been dealing with zombies for ten years has no clue about that stuff!? So she waves her hand dismissively and transfers schools!
But her new school, from top to bottom, reeks of a “cultivator cult” vibe…
The Inter-School Tournament livestream begins, and the “Qilin Gang Leader” goes viral!
Huh!? Their commander is the main damage dealer and tank? Their vanguard can swiftly dismantle enemy mechas while finding time to lubricate a bearing?
Heavy mechas launch with a catapult start!? And that most shameless mecha engineer!!!
Her mechas having blocky heads is one thing, but what’s with the transformation!?
Wait! While other engineers are repairing mechas, why is she off soloing a starbeast!?

185404.synopsis:
Geng Yu is a new employee at an interstellar company, assigned by his superior to the Salvation Department, specializing in missions to save the male leads of tragic novels, but his identity… is that of a background character.
As everyone knows, in tragic novels, while the protagonists suffer, background characters remain in the background; when the main couples engage in forced affection, he’s still in the background; when the protagonists go mad or die, he remains a background character.
Originally planning to just coast along and aim for a passing grade, offering the protagonist a bit of help when appropriate, Geng Yu heard this and did a sit-up: This won’t do!
He pondered deeply and decided to take an unconventional approach.
Thus, as a wealthy second-generation heir, he splurged extravagantly, insisting on hiring the top student protagonist as his companion; as the spoiled junior disciple of his sect, he single-handedly swung a heavy sword, then theatrically clutched his chest, demanding the senior brother protagonist carry him like a princess; as the aloof regent who kept his distance from beauty, he unprecedentedly appointed the general protagonist to enter his palace as a study companion…

205116.synopsis:
After waking in a brutal martial world as a bound medical hall servant, Chen Fei discovers a panel that turns impossible cultivation into something as simple as breathing. The body he inherits has poor talent, no status, and a twenty-year contract that makes every coin he earns property of the hall. Its former owner even trained himself to death trying to enter the martial path. Then the panel offers a way out: spend silver to simplify a technique. The difficult Extreme Mountain Breathing Technique becomes ordinary breathing, and every breath adds experience. What takes others years now rises by the moment.
But effortless practice does not mean an easy life. Chen Fei still needs money, manuals, food, and the strength to survive jealous rivals, ruthless overseers, bandits, and uncanny horrors beyond the county walls. His first breakthrough lets him reverse an ambush, but it also proves how merciless this world is. Each new technique promises another shortcut upward, while every step draws stronger enemies from a hierarchy built to keep nobodies at the bottom. To win his freedom, he must turn every breath, coin, and stolen moment into power before the world crushes him. In a realm where cultivation is suffering, Chen Fei makes mastery natural – and never stops rising.
